decision_clause: Ruled out: "pin the census ticket-owned path list literally" — because "every remaining product ticket then needs a census edit, and the deletion it was meant to catch is already caught by the focused-lane count guard".
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: diff.patch is zero bytes, and the tree corroborates it: nothing in the tree performs the task's requested behavior. packages/schema/src/capability.ts:551-562 still validates an evidence locator only by (a) presence of the field, (b) nonblank string, and (c) case-insensitive substring match against the per-runtime forbidden phrases held in FROZEN_RUNTIMES; there is no membership test of a locator against an approved-source set for the cell's runtime and frozen source class, so a nonempty locator naming an arbitrary undocumented source is still accepted. packages/schema/test/capability.test.ts covers only missing, blank, and forbidden-phrase locators (lines 262-300); there is no case asserting acceptance of the declared locators or rejection of a non-forbidden unapproved locator. No approved/allowlist-style source membership check exists anywhere in the tree. On the decision's subject matter, the census-derivation site is unchanged and still derives rather than enumerates: tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs:459-495 recomputes the whole ticket-owned set from ticket ownership bullets and deep-equals it against the path census the validator prints at scripts/validate-planning.mjs:953-954. No new literal enumeration of the ticket-owned census was added.
rationale: The base-to-finished diff is empty and the tree independently confirms it — the task (fail-closed approved-source validation for evidence locators, plus regression coverage) is not implemented anywhere. A change that adds nothing cannot adopt the ruled-out approach, and in particular no new literal census path enumeration was introduced; the derivation-based guard in tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs still re-derives the ticket-owned set and compares it to the validator's reported census, which is the shape the decision preserved. One thing worth stating plainly rather than burying: tests/planning-contract.test.mjs:34-35 does contain a full 64-path literal enumeration of ticket_owned_code_paths inside the pinned validator-output regexes, in a file the decision's scope names. That is the shape the decision describes. But the empty diff is direct evidence that this implementation did not put it there — it is base state, present before this change and untouched by it — and the same lines also carry the ticket_owned_code_files=64 count guard the decision cites as the sufficient replacement. Attributing that pre-existing pin to this implementation would be condemning the base tree rather than judging the change. Judged as the change it is, this tree stays outside the ruled-out approach. Confidence is medium rather than high only because the packet is degenerate: with no implementation at all, the COMPLIANT finding reflects an inert tree rather than a change that navigated the decision successfully.
